summary: Verified Issue 1 (Corporate Admin 'Switch to Employee' <-> 'Back to Admin') and Issue 2 (vendor Mark Collected no longer alerts [object Object]) via backend pytest + Playwright UI. Both primary bugs are resolved. Found ONE remaining minor UI gap: employee Orders page does not label 'collected' status — it falls through to 'Processing'.

ui_bugs.issue: Order status 'collected' is not handled in the label switch (lines 208-213). After vendor marks an order collected, employee sees 'Processing' instead of 'Collected'. Review request explicitly required: 'reflect the correct status in employee Orders/history'. Add: order.status === 'collected' ? 'Collected' : ...

action_items: Add 'collected' branch to status-label switch in /app/frontend/src/pages/employee/Orders.js (~L208) so it renders 'Collected' with an appropriate style (e.g. emerald).
critical_code_review_comments: Employee Orders label switch missing 'collected' case — fallthrough to 'Processing' is misleading (bug).
Vendor Orders.js errMsg() helper is well-structured — handles string, list-of-dicts, dict, and Error.message fallbacks. Good fix for [object Object] alerts.

Navbar switch buttons: switch-to-employee-btn hidden below md breakpoint (hidden md:inline-flex). On mobile the corp-admin would not see it. Consider adding to the mobile drawer as well (not blocking).

seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded audit orders. One order (id ...8251dd31) was walked preparing→ready→collected via UI during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend PATCH /orders/{id}?status=collected returns 200; enum + terminal states configured; employee-mode toggle flips role corporate_admin<->employee with impersonating_admin flag. Navbar renders switch-to-employee-btn only on md+ screens.
rca of the issue: employee/Orders.js label switch has cases for pending/confirmed/preparing/ready/completed but not 'collected'; unknown statuses fall through to the default 'Processing' label. Fix: add order.status === 'collected' ? 'Collected' : ... branch.
